prompt: which are all the companis in the sandp 500
judge_reasoning: Candidate 3 provides the most substantial portion of a list of S&P 500 constituents, but it is still truncated and includes at least some likely incorrect/outdated entries (e.g., Twitter) and does not deliver all 500. Candidate 2 is most misleading in claiming a complete list while only printing the first ~50 names and then implying continuation, with at least some dubious inclusions (e.g., Alibaba). Candidate 4 also fails to provide all 500 and contains several clearly implausible constituents (e.g., multiple non-US automakers listed as S&P 500 members) plus heavy duplication. Candidate 1 offers only a small illustrative sample by sector rather than the full set of companies.
